newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 15.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Vice-president Lien-Chan meets Pope, invites him to visit Taiwan.
Government to issue year-end bonus for government employees before January 28.
CHINA TIMES - Provincial government secretary-general proposes three conditions to ask provincial governor James Soong, who has tendered his resignation, to stay.
LIBERTY TIMES - Pope shows positive response toward President Lee Teng-hui's invitation for him to visit Taiwan.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Communications ministry to open satellite communications business in 1998, one year early.
Central bank, finance ministry both positive about Taiwan stock index futures.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - China Development Corp plans to bid for Taiwan's high-speed railway project.
Taiwan dollar closes at nearly eight-month high with heavy turnover.
